item.title: Port St. Lucie teen to serve as flag bearer at FIFA World Cup finals
item.description: Enrique Rosario Liz, named Southeast Region Youth of the Year for the Boys & Girls Clubs of America, was surprised with a trip to the World Cup finals on July 19.

item.title: Port St. Lucie teen Enrique Rosario Liz heading to FIFA World Cup finals as official flag bearer
item.description: A Port St. Lucie teenager named Southeast Region Youth of the Year for the Boys & Girls Clubs of America will serve as an official Coca-Cola flag bearer at the FIFA World Cup finals on July 19.

item.title: Port St. Lucie ranked No. 67 most stressed city in US, cited as 42nd most financially stressed
item.description: Port St. Lucie ranked as the 67th most stressed city in the United States and the 42nd most financially stressed in a new WalletHub study released this month.

item.title: DEA warns meth surge spreading to Treasure Coast counties as 120 pounds seized in two days
item.description: Federal agents in Palm Beach County seized nearly 120 pounds of methamphetamine in just two days, and officials warn the surge is beginning to spread to counties in the Treasure Coast.

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history and panoramic views from 105-step climb
item.description: Built in 1860, the Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse has guided ships along Florida's Atlantic coast for more than 165 years and offers visitors panoramic views after a 105-step climb.

item.title: Justin Bieber, Madonna join World Cup final halftime show
item.description: Justin Bieber will join fellow headliners Madonna, Shakira and BTS in a star-studded, Super Bowl-style halftime show at the World Cup final.

item.title: Karolina Muchova defeats Coco Gauff to reach Wimbledon final after dramatic tiebreaker
item.description: Karolina Muchova ended Coco Gauff's run at Wimbledon with a 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 (10) victory Thursday that ended with a drama-filled tiebreaker.

item.title: Florida back-to-school sales tax holiday runs July 20 through August 20 with clothing, computers and supplies exempt
